arxiv-2012-11625.title: Shadow surface states in topological Kondo insulators
arxiv-2012-11625.creator: Areg Ghazaryan, Emilian M. Nica, Onur Erten, Pouyan Ghaemi
arxiv-2012-11625.description: Abstract The surface states of 3D topological insulators in general have negligible quantum oscillations when the chemical potential is tuned to the Dirac points. In contrast, we find that topological Kondo insulators can support surface states with an arbitrarily large Fermi surface when the chemical potential is pinned to the Dirac point.

arxiv-2205-06955.title: Robust Design of Federated Learning for Edge-Intelligent Networks
arxiv-2205-06955.creator: Qiao Qi, Xiaoming Chen
arxiv-2205-06955.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Qiao Qi, Xiaoming Chen. Mass data traffics, low-latency wireless services and advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technologies have driven the emergence of a new paradigm for wireless networks, namely edge-intelligent networks, which are more efficient and flexible than traditional cloud-intelligent networks. Considering users’ privacy, model sharing-based federated learning (FL) that migrates model parameters but not private data from edge devices to a central cloud is particularly attractive for edge-intelligent networks.

arxiv-2307-04749.title: Divide, Evaluate, and Refine: Evaluating and Improving Text-to-Image Alignment with Iterative VQA Feedback
arxiv-2307-04749.creator: Jaskirat Singh, Liang Zheng
arxiv-2307-04749.description: Abstract The field of text-conditioned image generation has made unparalleled progress with the recent advent of latent diffusion models. While remarkable, as the complexity of given text input increases, the state-of-the-art diffusion models may still fail in generating images which accurately convey the semantics of the given prompt.

arxiv-2309-07434.title: Exact and local compression of quantum bipartite states
arxiv-2309-07434.creator: Kohtaro Kato
arxiv-2309-07434.description: Abstract We study exact local compression of a quantum bipartite state; that is, applying local quantum operations to reduce the dimensions of the Hilbert spaces while perfectly preserving the correlation. We provide a closed-form expression for the minimal achievable dimensions, formulated as a minimization of the Schmidt rank of a particular pure state constructed from the given state.

arxiv-2310-05975.title: Reducing cartel recruitment and upholding the rule of law is the only way to reduce violence in Mexico
arxiv-2310-05975.creator: Raul Rojas
arxiv-2310-05975.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Recently, the paper I want to comment on was published in Science [ 1 ] . The main conclusion is also the title of the paper: “Reducing cartel recruitment is the only way to lower violence in Mexico”.

arxiv-2312-07001.title: Stein Coverage: a Variational Inference Approach to Distribution-matching Multisensor Deployment
arxiv-2312-07001.creator: Donipolo Ghimire and Solmaz S. Kia, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2312-07001.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Donipolo Ghimire and Solmaz S. Kia, Senior Member, IEEE. This paper examines the spatial coverage optimization problem for multiple sensors in a known convex environment, where the coverage service of each sensor is heterogeneous and anisotropic. We introduce the Stein Coverage algorithm, a distribution-matching coverage approach that aims to place sensors at positions and orientations such that their collective coverage distribution is as close as possible to the event distribution.

arxiv-2502-13225.title: Entropy of spatial network with applications to non-extensive statistical mechanics
arxiv-2502-13225.creator: O.K. Kazemi, S.M. Taheri
arxiv-2502-13225.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by O.K. Kazemi, S.M. Taheri. A new method is proposed for analyzing complexity and studying the information in random geometric networks using Tsallis entropy tool. Tsallis entropy of the ensemble of random geometric networks is calculated based on the components of the random connection model on the point process which is obtained by connecting the points with a probability that depends on their relative positions (10.1016/j.indag.2022.05.002, 2022).

arxiv-2505-03753.title: An application of Gelfand’s formula in approximating the roots of polynomials
arxiv-2505-03753.creator: Frank J. Hall
arxiv-2505-03753.description: Abstract The purpose of this paper is to show how Gelfand’s formula and balancing can be used to improve the upper and lower bounds of the spectrum of a companion matrix associated with a given real or complex polynomial. Examples and other related ideas are provided. AMS Subj. Class.

arxiv-2511-05114.title: Usando LLMs para Programar Jogos de Tabuleiro e Variações
arxiv-2511-05114.creator: Álvaro Guglielmin Becker 1, Lana Bertoldo Rossato 1, Anderson Rocha Tavares 1
arxiv-2511-05114.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Álvaro Guglielmin Becker 1, Lana Bertoldo Rossato 1, Anderson Rocha Tavares 1. Resumo Creating programs to represent board games can be a time-consuming task. Large Language Models (LLMs) arise as appealing tools to expedite this process, given their capacity to efficiently generate code from simple contextual information. In this work, we propose a method to test how capable three LLMs (Claude, DeepSeek and ChatGPT) are at creating code for board games, as well as new variants of existing games.

arxiv-2512-11897.title: Contact lifts and Hölder lifts to central extension of Carnot groups
arxiv-2512-11897.creator: Yihan Cui
arxiv-2512-11897.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yihan Cui. We consider the existence problem of lift F F of a map f f between Carnot group with different smoothness, where we use central extension to define lifting. Our main result is the existence of the contact lifts of Lipschitz and Sobolev maps and the rigidity result for the contact lift of quasiconformal maps: a quasiconformal map admits a contact lift then it is bi-Lipschitz.

arxiv-2601-01110.title: Exploring the formation mechanisms of tidal structures in globular clusters of extragalactic origin
arxiv-2601-01110.creator: Shouzhi Wang, Jundan Nie ,, Biwei Jiang, Hao Tian, Chao Liu, Ying-Hua Zhang
arxiv-2601-01110.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Shouzhi Wang, Jundan Nie ,, Biwei Jiang, Hao Tian, Chao Liu, Ying-Hua Zhang. Tidal structures around globular clusters provide valuable insights into cluster evolution and the hierarchical assembly of the Milky Way. Using wide-field imaging data from the DESI Legacy Survey combined with a color-magnitude matched-filter technique, we perform a systematic analysis of extra-tidal features in 28 Galactic globular clusters of likely extragalactic origin, representing the largest homogeneous sample examined in this context to date.

plos-pone-0352255.creator: Khushboo Goel, Sirjana Dahal
plos-pone-0352255.description: Tooth loss and associated factors during periodontal maintenance care in young adults with Grade C Periodontitis at a tertiary care center in Kathmandu, Nepal

pmc-11436150.title: A Study on Machine Learning-Based Feature Classification for the Early Diagnosis of Blade Rubbing
pmc-11436150.creator: Dong-hee Park, Byeong-keun Choi
pmc-11436150.description: This research focuses on the development of a machine learning-based approach for the early diagnosis of blade rubbing in rotary machinery. In this paper, machine learning-based diagnostic methods are used for blade rubbing early diagnosis, and the faults are simulated using experimental models.

pmc-11670235.title: Internal feedback circuits among MEX-5, MEX-6, and PLK-1 maintain faithful patterning in the Caenorhabditis elegans embryo
pmc-11670235.creator: Alexandre Pierre Vaudano, Françoise Schwager, Monica Gotta, Sofia Barbieri
pmc-11670235.description: SignificanceProteins get asymmetrically enriched in the one-cell Caenorhabditis elegans embryo thanks to reaction–diffusion mechanisms that often rely on complex feedback loops. Starting from the investigation of the biophysical mechanisms of MEX-6 gradient formation, we here unveil a complex interplay among the cytoplasmic RNA-binding proteins MEX-5 and MEX-6 and the polo-like kinase PLK-1.

pmc-11671579.title: IL33-induced neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) mediate a positive feedback loop for synovial inflammation and NET amplification in rheumatoid arthritis
pmc-11671579.creator: Jifeng Tang, Jinfang Xia, Huali Gao, Renquan Jiang, Lianbo Xiao, Huiming Sheng, Jinpiao Lin
pmc-11671579.description: This study investigated the mechanisms driving the induction and sustained presence of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) in the synovial microenvironment of rheumatoid arthritis (RA). Synovial tissue and fluid samples were collected from patients with RA and osteoarthritis (OA), and NET levels and cytokine concentrations were measured using a cytometric bead array and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA).

pmc-11689200.title: RESTORING GLUTATHIONE HAS BENEFITS FOR OLDER ADULTS AND MICE
pmc-11689200.creator: George Taffet
pmc-11689200.description: The role and importance of mitochondrial function and glutathione is not well recognized by clinicians Glutathione is the most abundant intracellular anti-oxidant and is responsible for detoxifying many reactive, potentially harmful molecules and is most older adults are glutathione deficient because of low free Cysteine and especially Glycine. Supplementation with Glycine and N-Acetyl Cysteine is able to restore cellular glutathione.

pmc-13418228.title: Systems and policy factors affecting service delivery for homeless adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities
pmc-13418228.creator: Whitney Thurman, Elizabeth Heitkemper, Tara Hutson
pmc-13418228.description: BackgroundIntellectual and developmental disability (IDD) is characterized by impairment of cognitive function that results in daily living limitations. Adults with IDD face barriers to meeting basic needs and must navigate multiple public systems to access services. The housing affordability crisis has contributed to a disproportionate overrepresentation of adults with IDD who experience homelessness.

pmc-13591493.title: PgZHD18‐PgWDR5b increases basal thermotolerance in Physalis grisea by lignin biosynthesis dependent on H3K4me3
pmc-13591493.creator: Hong Li, Guanzhuo Kong, Yihan Zhang, Yan Ren, Jiayin Niu, Xiaochun Zhao, Qiaofang Shi, Yihe Yu
pmc-13591493.description: SUMMARY Physalis grisea is a widely valued orphan crop with medicinal properties and edible functional fruits. Under global warming, high temperature stress (HTS) severely restricts the growth and development of P. grisea, while the epigenetic regulatory mechanism underlying its HTS response remains largely unclear.
